entities.name: Joseph ben Judah of Ceuta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph ben Judah of Ceuta was a Jewish physician and poet, and disciple of Maimonides. Maimonides wrote his work, The Guide for the Perplexed, for Joseph.
